hero.heading: Built By Engineers Who Call Liberia Home
hero.text: LIBCURRENT RENEWABLE exists to provide reliable, safe, affordable, and sustainable electrical and solar energy solutions that improve the lives of individuals, families, businesses, and communities across Liberia.

story.heading: Powering Progress, One Installation At A Time
paragraphs: LIBCURRENT RENEWABLE was founded to close a simple but urgent gap: Liberian homes, businesses, and industries deserve electrical work and solar systems built to last — not quick fixes that fail in the rainy season.

Our engineers and technicians bring hands-on field experience across residential wiring, commercial power systems, and solar installations, backed by quality-tested materials and a safety-first process on every job site.
Today, we serve homeowners, businesses, construction companies, government offices, and NGOs across Monrovia and beyond — with the same standard on every project, big or small.

vision.title: Our Vision
